bio: Sangeeta Singh-Kurtz is a fiction writer and freelance journalist. She was a staff writer at *[New York Magazine](https://nymag.com/)* for five years, where she was the first to report on [intriguing](https://www.thecut.com/article/ai-artificial-intelligence-chatbot-replika-boyfriend.html) [communities](https://www.thecut.com/2022/04/repladies-fake-luxury-bags.html) that have since been covered to death. While at *New York* she mostly wrote about [wealth](https://www.vulture.com/article/white-lotus-thailand-hotel-four-seasons-koh-samui.html), [aspiration](https://www.thecut.com/2023/02/buccal-fat-removal-dissolve-fillers-bella-hadid-angular-face.html), and [powerful idiots](https://www.thecut.com/article/emma-grede-jens-grede-kim-kardashian-skims-kylie-jenner-khy-profile.html). She also hosted an award-winning business podcast with *[Vox and The Verge](https://open.spotify.com/episode/5ozM7Npsoz3Sp716jHG1Rl)*, and authored and illustrated a series of swashbuckling travelogues on *[Substack](https://pleinair.substack.com/)*.

She began her career eleven years ago in local news before joining the business publication *Quartz*, and has since written for *Architectural Digest*, *Marie Claire*, *A24*, and more. She lives in Tokyo, where she recently completed her debut novel, which she would describe as if Patricia Highsmith did *Eat Pray Love*. Her short story *The Cicada* was nominated for *Nimrod International*’s Katherine Anne Porter Prize and is currently being developed into a short film.
In her free time she toils at Japanese, yoga, and horseback archery, which she practices in China and Mongolia.

The Couple Behind the Skims-Industrial Complex
